name: Garbi Finvest Limited
about: Garbi Finvest Limited operates as a non-banking finance company. The company is involved in investment activities, including advancing and financing activities. It also engages in acquisition and dealing in shares, securities, and other financial instruments, along with lending and advancing of money; and undertakes trading activities and deals in land, buildings, and other properties. The company was formerly known as Golden Properties & Traders Limited. Garbi Finvest Limited was incorporated in 1982 and is based in Kolkata, India.
